_meta.source: Music Architect V7 — Production Guide Rev 1.0

bpm_buckets.character: Mid-tempo J-Pop / City Pop / ballad; quarter note = 510.6 ms; lush reverb and wide harmonic bed
Up-tempo idol pop; quarter note = 452.8 ms; bright, energetic chorus; strings + vocal synergy
Fast J-Pop; 1/16 = 105.3 ms; crisp acoustic-hybrid drums; keep pads shorter to prevent wash

effect_chain.params: 18 Hz, 12 dB/oct Butterworth — removes sub-sonic content, preserves sub fundamental
Attack +2 dB, Sustain -1 dB — gentle definition matching acoustic-hybrid kit
Ratio 4:1, Thr -12 dBFS, Attack 8 ms, Release 941.2 ms (=2×qn@127.5BPM), Knee 3 dB, GR 3-4 dB
Drive +1-2 dB, Mix 25%, tape model, THD 2-3%, low distortion preserves clean sub under busy vocal arrangement — pre-compressor
Bell -3 dB @300-400 Hz Q=1.4 (boxy removal); higher click content +1.5 dB @4 kHz for small-speaker translation
Ceiling -7.0 dBFS true peak, Lookahead 1 ms

bass.name: Bass
bass.owns: Sub 20-80 Hz + Bass 80-250 Hz (melodic sine/tri or fingered electric)
bass.role: Melodic harmonic root — live-band or melodic synth bass

effect_chain.params: 24-30 Hz, 12 dB/oct — preserves full sub-bass weight without infrasonic waste
Bell +2 dB @fundamental Q=1.2; triangle-derived odd-harmonic bass keeps melodic un-masked under vocal chords
Ratio 6:1, Thr -20 dBFS, Attack 1-2 ms, Release 235.3 ms (=1/8÷2@127.5BPM), GR 3-5 dB
Drive +2-4 dB, Mix 35%, tube model, THD 3-5%, post-EQ — harmonic content for small speakers
Mono below 120 Hz; gentle width above 120 Hz (100%)
Ceiling -8.0 dBFS true peak, Lookahead 1.5 ms, Release 100 ms

chords.name: Chords
chords.owns: Low-mid 250-500 Hz + Mid 500 Hz-2 kHz (piano, strings, warm pad)

effect_chain.params: Bell -2 dB @800-1200 Hz Q=1.0 (melody/vocal pocket); moderate low-pass 5 kHz keeps brightness below melody centroid
Ratio 3:1, Thr -18 dBFS, Attack 15 ms, Release 470.6 ms (=qn@127.5BPM), GR 2-4 dB
Rate 0.35 Hz, Depth 15-25%, Mix 18%, 2-3 voices, Spread 60%
Decay 1.5 s, Pre-delay 29.4 ms (=1/16 frac@127.5BPM), HPF 300 Hz, LPF 7 kHz, Mix 14%
Drive +1.5 dB, Mix 20%, tape model, THD 2-4%, post-comp — warm without harsh

melody.name: Melody
melody.owns: Mid 500 Hz-2 kHz + High-mid 2-6 kHz (vocal-style synth / strings lead)

effect_chain.params: Shelf +2-3 dB @3 kHz, 6 dB/oct; formant-shaped envelope centered 800 Hz-3 kHz mirrors vocal presence
Ratio 2.5:1, Thr -16 dBFS, Attack 10 ms, Release 313.7 ms (=half-qn@127.5BPM), Knee 6 dB, GR 4-6 dB — preserves melodic dynamics
Drive +2 dB, Mix 25%, HF roll-off 12 kHz — smooth brightness
Time 352.9 ms (dotted-8th@127.5BPM), Feedback 20-28%, HPF 400 Hz, LPF 5 kHz, ping-pong
Decay 1.3 s, Pre-delay 29.4 ms, HPF 400 Hz, LPF 8 kHz, Mix 12%
+2 dB high shelf @10 kHz (bright J-Pop air); Ceiling -5 dBFS true peak

arp.name: Arp
arp.role: Bright inharmonic arp sparkle — rhythmic subdivision

effect_chain.params: Bell +1.5 dB @4-6 kHz Q=1.2 (bright inharmonic partials); Bell -3 dB @2.9 kHz Q=4 (melody carve)
Ratio 3:1, Attack 3 ms, Release 117.6 ms (=1/16@127.5BPM), GR 3-5 dB — articulate under vocal-style Melody
Time 352.9 ms (dotted-8th@127.5BPM), Feedback 22%, HPF 600 Hz
Decay 0.6 s (≈0.4× Chords RT60), Pre-delay 14.7 ms, HPF 700 Hz, Mix 10%
Width 40-60% above 500 Hz; Ceiling -7 dBFS true peak

pads.name: Pads
pads.owns: Sides, 200 Hz-8 kHz (warm strings / soft choir pad)

effect_chain.params: HPF 200-250 Hz 12 dB/oct; LPF 9 kHz 12 dB/oct (gentle, not too bright)
Bell -2 dB @1-2 kHz Q=0.8 (vocal-range space); slow attack 500 ms-1 s sits unobtrusively behind Melody
Ratio 2:1, Thr -22 dBFS, Attack 30 ms, Release 1882.4 ms (=4×qn@127.5BPM), GR 2-3 dB
Rate 0.2-0.4 Hz, Depth 30-50%, Mix 40%, Spread 100%, 3 voices
Ratio 3:1, Thr -24 dBFS, Attack 5 ms, Release 941.2 ms (=2×qn@127.5BPM), GR 2-3 dB
Decay 3.5 s (longest of all tracks), Pre-delay 58.8 ms, HPF 350 Hz, Mix 30%
Width 50-80% above 200 Hz, Correlation floor +0.2, Output limiter -10 dBFS

stabs.name: Stabs
stabs.owns: Mid 500 Hz-6 kHz transients (brass / piano stab)

effect_chain.params: Attack +5 dB, Sustain -6 dB — sharp hammer transient 2-4 ms for clean rhythmic accents
Bell +2 dB @2-3 kHz Q=1.0; +1 dB HF shelf @8 kHz for J-Pop bright character
Ratio 4:1, Thr -14 dBFS, Attack 2 ms, Release 235.3 ms (=1/8@127.5BPM), GR 5-8 dB
Decay 0.15-0.4 s, Pre-delay 14.7 ms, HPF 400 Hz, Mix 22%
Haas spread 12 ms side only, Width 120%; Ceiling -6 dBFS

fx.name: FX
fx.owns: Air 2 kHz-20 kHz + atmospheric wind textures
fx.role: Sparkle/shimmer riser + cinematic atmosphere / vocal breath

effect_chain.params: Bright bell-like sweep upward for J-Pop optimistic build; wind/atmosphere: slow LPF filter; sweep 200 Hz→8 kHz
Bell -3 dB where overlapping Melody/Lead, Q=1.5
Ratio 2.5:1, Thr -28 dBFS, Attack 10 ms, Release 941.2 ms (=2×qn@127.5BPM), GR 2-4 dB
Decay ≥3.5 s (≥Pads RT60), Pre-delay 29.4 ms, HPF 500 Hz, Mix 45% — lush cinematic space
Width 60-80% (mid-side); enveloping but not as wide as EDM — intimate J-Pop scale
Ceiling -11 dBFS; LPF 16 kHz 12 dB/oct
300-500 Hz, 12 dB/oct (hats); 200 Hz for tambourine; brighter tuning 200-250 Hz snare fundamental
Attack +3 dB, Sustain -2 dB — light, natural acoustic-hybrid character
Ratio 4:1, Attack 1 ms, Release 117.6 ms (=1/16@127.5BPM), GR 2-3 dB
Shelf +2 dB @8 kHz, 6 dB/oct (J-Pop bright shimmer 4-8 kHz); Bell -2 dB @900 Hz Q=1.2
Decay 0.15-0.3 s, Pre-delay 14.7 ms, HPF 800 Hz, Mix 12%
Width 30-50% above 800 Hz, Pan spread ±30-50%; Drive +1 dB, Mix 20%, tape — gentle natural tone

intro.name: Intro
intro.owns: First 4-8 bars, piano/strings sparse or vocal a cappella

effect_chain.params: Sweeps from 400 Hz→20 Hz over 4 bars (7.53 s at 127.5 BPM); gentle LPF close 20 kHz→3 kHz in pre-chorus; 12 dB/oct
Bell -2 dB where borrowed tracks overlap, Q=1.0
Ratio 2:1, Thr -22 dBFS, Attack 20 ms, Release 941.2 ms (=2×qn@127.5BPM), GR 2-3 dB
Decay 3.5 s, Pre-delay 58.8 ms, wet% ramps down as intro progresses — 'arriving' depth cue
Ceiling -9 dBFS true peak

drum.chain: EQ (HPF 30 Hz) -> Comp (3:1, 15 ms attack, gentle) -> Saturation (tape, 2-3% THD)

synth.chain: EQ (broad, vocal-clearing carve at 1-3 kHz) -> Comp (2:1, glue) -> Stereo Widener (moderate)

master.chain: EQ (gentle) -> Bus Comp (1.8:1, 25 ms attack, 1.5-2.5 dB max GR) -> Saturation (0.5% THD) -> Limiter (True Peak -1.0 dBTP)

parallel_compression.reasoning: Conservative 20-30% wet blend preserves J-Pop's dynamic range and transient punch; moderate release (60-100 ms) respects natural acoustic-hybrid kit decay without squashing live-band feel.

kick.exclusive_claim: Higher click content 3-5 kHz for small-speaker translation. Sub fundamental clean, THD<3%.

bass.exclusive_claim: Triangle/sine harmonic rolloff; resonant peak at 1.2x fundamental; stays below 250 Hz Chords boundary.

chords.exclusive_claim: Wide dynamic range natural inharmonicity; vocal accompaniment band. LP at 5 kHz.

melody.exclusive_claim: Formant-shaped 800 Hz-3 kHz vocal-mimicking centroid; bright J-Pop sparkle to 6 kHz.

arp.exclusive_claim: Music-box / koto inharmonic partials; -3 dB notch at melody presence peak.

pads.exclusive_claim: Side channel only; mid scooped -2 dB at 1-2 kHz; warm low-pass 5 kHz.

stabs.exclusive_claim: Time-sliced: <15% duty cycle per bar; bright orchestral accent.

fx.exclusive_claim: Bright bell sparkle sweep; vocal breath/ad-lib -35 dBFS ambient; never masks melody.

percussion.exclusive_claim: Tambourine shimmer 4-8 kHz; snare 200-250 Hz fundamental brighter than typical.

intro.exclusive_claim: Melodic ballad piano/strings opening; a cappella vocal allowed; muted after first verse.

streaming.notes: Platform-normalised on ingest. M/S mastering mandatory: side HPF 200 Hz, side shelf +1.5-2.5 dB @8 kHz. Stem naming: jpop_gen{N}_seed_{id}_{track}_v{ver}.wav

broadcast.notes: EBU R128 ±0.5 LU tolerance; anything outside is rejected at ingest.

sync_licensing.notes: Stems mandatory. Vocal stem critical — J-Pop vocal layer must be delivered separately. M/S insert per Section H J-Pop spec.

branches.kick_desc: Pure sine sub kick — minimal acoustic-adjacent J-Pop variant
Bright acoustic-electronic hybrid kick — primary J-Pop default (B1 = warm centroid 800-2 kHz)

arp.avoid: D2-D3 (fourth dense layer risks IMD product density)

branches.kick_desc: Dark slow-attack sub kick — J-Pop ballad / cinematic bridge variant

bass.avoid: A2-A3 (two slow-attack low elements erase transient anchor)

chords.codes: B1-B3, any D, any A, R1-R2

arp.avoid: A2-A3 (slow arp defeats rhythmic sparkle purpose in J-Pop)
